title: Bryndza and Cheese Casserole
description: A vegan take on the traditional casserole, using exotic spices and dutch cheese alternatives.

ingredients.name: Exotic spices (such as paprika and cumin)
Vegan milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Combine the Dutch vegan cheese, Bryndza cheese alternative, and exotic spices in a bowl.
Add the casserole to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour in the vegan milk and stir until the mixture is smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the casserole mixture to the pan and stir until heated through.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
